exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.instructions:
Grip a pull-up bar overhand, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders relaxed.
Keep your legs still and breathe steadily.
Hold for time, then step down with control.

exercises.name: Active Hang
exercises.instructions:
Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down and back, away from your ears, without bending your elbows.
Keep your ribs down and legs together.
Hold for time.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.instructions:
Start on hands and knees, back flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are straight.
Pause, keeping your hips level.
Return and switch sides.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchopper
exercises.instructions:
Set a cable high and hold the handle with both hands.
Stand side-on with feet wide.
Pull diagonally down across your body, turning through your torso and hips.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.instructions:
Wedge one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder with control.

exercises.name: Toes to Bar
exercises.instructions:
Hang from a pull-up bar.
Brace your core and raise your feet to touch the bar.
Lower your legs with control without swinging.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.instructions:
Hold the sled handles with arms extended and body leaning forward.
Drive through the balls of your feet with short, powerful steps.
Push for the set distance or time.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.instructions:
Hold a medicine ball at your chest, facing a wall.
Squat down, then stand up fast and throw the ball to a target on the wall.
Catch it and go straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.instructions:
Stand facing a sturdy box.
Swing your arms and jump, landing softly on the box with both feet.
Stand up fully, then step down.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.instructions:
Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your knees are at about 90 degrees.
Keep your feet flat and knees over your ankles.
Hold for time.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.instructions:
Strap your feet in and hold the handle.
Push with your legs, lean back slightly, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Return in reverse: arms, body, then legs.
Keep a steady pace for time or distance.

exercises.name: Assault Bike
exercises.instructions:
Sit on the fan bike and hold the handles.
Push and pull the handles while pedalling.
Keep a steady pace, or sprint for intervals.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions:
Attach an ankle strap to a low cable.
Hold the frame and kick your strapped leg straight back, squeezing your glute.
Return with control and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.instructions:
Stand beside a landmine barbell in a staggered stance.
Grip the end of the bar with one hand and row it up to your hip.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Plate Pinch
exercises.instructions:
Pinch two weight plates together, smooth sides out, with your fingers and thumb.
Stand tall with your arm straight at your side.
Hold for time, then switch hands.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.instructions:
Kneel with your ankles anchored under a pad or by a partner.
Keeping hips straight, lower your body forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions:
Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is flat from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower with control.
